messages:
tori_devex: recapping today's design review: proposing a compact 'invoke strip' in the playground run history — groups tool calls, shows a tiny schema badge, and an expand chevron for diffs. quick reactions?

alex_design: like the idea. can you paste a tiny ascii so I can eyeball spacing on mobile? worried about long tool ids wrapping.

ravi_eng: ascii guess: 
[Assistant] 
• [S] TranslateText v2 · 3 calls · avg 35ms · p95 110ms · schema changes ▸
• [U] FetchProfile · 1 call · schema ok

mike_prod: keep historical snapshot of schema used for the run. do not silently rewrite old entries. add an explicit "Re-run with latest schema" CTA.

sana_a11y: accessibility checklist: chips must be at least 2rem hit area, visible focus ring, aria-label pattern like "invoke group: TranslateText, 3 calls". badges must hit 4.5:1 and not rely on color alone.

alex_design: microcopy: prefer "Schema used" for snapshot label and "Schema changes" for diff affordance. badge pair: "Structured" / "Unstructured". preserve expand state when user pages.

ravi_eng: perf notes: lazy-load diff payloads, and avoid expanding diffs for runs with >20 calls by default. show avg+p95 inline, allow expand to per-call timings.

tori_devex: UX question: when many tools are called in one run, collapse to a "+N more" summary with a single expand. who wants that?

mike_prod: yes. also show a short summary line when collapsed: first 2 tools + "+8 more".

sana_a11y: keyboard nav: Tab into run history, Arrow keys jump across chips, Enter expands, Esc closes. SR should announce "expanded schema diff, 3 changes". ensure icons have accessible names.

ci-bot: deploy-checks: add unit tests for 0/1/many tool-calls, extremely long tool ids, keyboard nav E2E. CI will flag missing tests. :robot_face:

tori_devex: captured actions: 1) add invoke strip with structured badge + name + counts + timings + diff affordance; 2) persist per-run schema snapshot + lazy diffs; 3) preserve expand state across pages; 4) a11y: hit targets, ARIA, contrast, keyboard flow; 5) collapse "+N more" pattern for big runs; 6) CTA to re-run with latest schema; 7) CI tests for edge cases. I'll update the prototype and post screenshots. thanks all! :tada:
